channel.title: Sound baths in Boulder · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Boulder, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Sound Bath Experience
item.description: A sound bath on crystal singing bowls, chimes and drums facilitated by Terri Slezak at 1455 Dixon Ave in Lafayette, Tuesday evening; free to attend, donations accepted, adults 18 and over. Where: 1455 Dixon Ave, Boulder. Price: Free. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sound-bath-experience-2026-09-08-1455-dixon-ave/

item.title: Wednesday Meditation

Where: Unity of Boulder Spiritual Center, Boulder. Price: Free (donations appreciated). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/wednesday-meditation-2026-09-09-unity-of-boulder-spiritual-center/
